name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.interact.SpeechVoiceInteractLandingClockActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user follows the clock-style offer after an interactive video ad. It shows the clock promotion and its reward action.
disableEffect: The clock-style ad offer and its associated viewing reward will no longer open.
